nightTariffStart.description: A time when the night begins

pricing__pricePerSession.description: Price per session. Only applicable with flat rate tariffs. Up to 5 digits after the decimal point depending on the currency precision.

pricing__connectionFee.description: Connection fee. A fixed fee that is applied at the start of the charging session. Up to 5 digits after the decimal point depending on the currency precision.

pricing__pricePerKwh.description: Price per kWh. Up to 5 digits after the decimal point depending on the currency precision.

pricing__dayPricePerKwh.description: Price per kWh during the day. Applicable for duration+energy time of day. Up to 5 digits after the decimal point depending on the currency precision.

pricing__nightPricePerKwh.description: Price per kWh during the night. Applicable for duration+energy time of day. Up to 5 digits after the decimal point depending on the currency precision.

pricing__pricePeriodInMinutes.description: Charging period. In minutes. It defines the time-period for charging a fee.

pricing__pricePerPeriod.description: Charging fee per period. Applicable for duration+energy. Up to 5 digits after the decimal point depending on the currency precision.

pricing__durationFeeLimit.description: Duration fee limit for the whole session if fee is applied.

pricing__dayPricePerPeriod.description: Charging fee per period during the day. Applicable for duration+energy time of day. Up to 5 digits after the decimal point depending on the currency precision.

pricing__nightPricePerPeriod.description: Charging fee per period during the night. Applicable for duration+energy time of day. Up to 5 digits after the decimal point depending on the currency precision.

pricing__dayIdleFeePerMinute.displayName: Pricing - Day Idle Fee Per Minute
pricing__dayIdleFeePerMinute.description: Charging fee per minute during the day. Applicable for duration+energy time of day. Up to 5 digits after the decimal point depending on the currency precision.

pricing__nightIdleFeePerMinute.displayName: Pricing - Night Idle Fee Per Minute
pricing__nightIdleFeePerMinute.description: Charging fee per minute during the night. Applicable for duration+energy time of day. Up to 5 digits after the decimal point depending on the currency precision.

pricing__idleFeePerMinute.description: Idle fee per minute. A fee per minute that is applied during idle period (no charging). Up to 5 digits after the decimal point depending on the currency precision.

pricing__idleFeeGracePeriodMinutes.displayName: Pricing - Idle Fee Grace Period Minutes
pricing__idleFeeGracePeriodMinutes.description: Idle fee grace period (min). Optional. When idle period (no charging) is detected during a session the user is given this grace period to remove the vehicle, before idle fee starts applying.

pricing__idlePricingPeriodInMinutes.displayName: Pricing - Idle Pricing Period In Minutes
pricing__idlePricingPeriodInMinutes.description: Idle fee per minute. A fee per minute that is applied during idle period (no charging).

pricing__idleFeePeriodStart.description: Defined start time for the application of idle fee.

pricing__idleFeePeriodEnd.description: Defined end time for the application of idle fee.

pricing__idleFeeLimit.description: Idle fee limit for the whole session if fee is applied.

pricing__connectionFeeMinimumSessionDura.displayName: Pricing - Connection Fee Minimum Session Duration
pricing__connectionFeeMinimumSessionDura.description: Connection Fee Minimum Session Duration (min). Optional.

pricing__connectionFeeMinimumSessionEner.displayName: Pricing - Connection Fee Minimum Session Energy
pricing__connectionFeeMinimumSessionEner.description: Connection Fee Minimum Session Energy (kWh). Optional. Up to 5 digits after the decimal point depending on the currency precision.

pricing__minPrice.description: Min. price. Sets a minimum total amount per session.

pricing__preAuthorizeAmount.description: Pre-authorize amount. The amount to pre-authorize before starting a session. Up to 5 digits after the decimal point depending on the currency precision.

pricing__taxID.description: If Multi-tax Support has been enabled in the Ampeco.CHARGE settings, you can provide the taxId for the tariff here.

pricing__chargePointElectricityRate.description: Use the Electricity Rate of the Charge Point that is already attached and aims to track the electricity costs.

pricing__fallbackElectricityRateId.description: When ChargePointElectricityRate is set to *false*, the Electricity Rate ID MUST be supplied in order the electricity rates for the tariff to be known.

pricing__markupFixedFeePerKwh.displayName: Pricing - Markup Fixed Fee Per Kwh

pricing__flexibleMarkUpAsFixedPerKwh__de.displayName: Pricing - Flexible Mark Up As Fixed Per Kwh - Default Price
pricing__flexibleMarkUpAsFixedPerKwh__de.description: Set price for the intervals not specified in `intervalPricing` field.

pricing__flexibleMarkUpAsFixedPerKwh__in.displayName: Pricing - Flexible Mark Up As Fixed Per Kwh - Interval Pricing
pricing__flexibleMarkUpAsFixedPerKwh__in.description: The time interval must be always the same and should not exceed the 24-hour mark. It could be either 15 min, 30 min or 60 min. The startAt and endAt must comply with this restriction.

startsAt.description: The start time of the period. Formatted as hours:minutes. Should be provided in the local time zone and not in UTC.

endsAt.description: The end time of the period. Formatted as hours:minutes. Should be provided in the local time zone and not in UTC.

price.description: The price that will apply for the given price period. Must include tax.

pricing__multiPricePerKwh.description:
Create the price levels according to the kWh.
The first level must have zero value for **firstKwh**.
The last level must have an infinity value for **lastKwh**.

pricing__multiPricePerDuration.description:
Create the price levels according to the duration of the session from the time the charging started.
The first level must have zero value for **firstUnit**.
The last level must have an infinity value for **lastUnit**.

pricing__multiIdleFee.description:
Different price levels could be created depending on the duration of the idle period.
The first level must have zero value for **firstUnit**.
The last level must have an infinity value for **lastUnit**.

pricing__regularUsePeriod.description: In minutes. Only for the Peak power level tariff.

pricing__pricePeriods__connectionFeePeri.displayName: Pricing - Price Periods - Connection Fee Periods - Fee

pricing__pricePeriods__energyFeePeriods_.displayName: Pricing - Price Periods - Energy Fee Periods - Fee

pricing__pricePeriods__durationFeePeriod.displayName: Pricing - Price Periods - Duration Fee Periods - Fee

pricing__pricePeriods__idleFeePeriods__f.displayName: Pricing - Price Periods - Idle Fee Periods - Fee

pricing__daysWhenApplied.description: When left empty, this means that this is the standard pricing that would be applied in general without taking into consideration the day.

idleFeeGracePeriodMinutes.description: Idle fee grace period (min). Optional. When idle period (no charging) is detected during a session the user is given this grace period to remove the vehicle, before idle fee starts applying.

idlePricingPeriodInMinutes.description: Idle fee per minute. A fee per minute that is applied during idle period (no charging).

connectionFeeMinimumSessionDuration.description: Connection Fee Minimum Session Duration (min). Optional.

connectionFeeMinimumSessionEnergy.description: Connection Fee Minimum Session Energy (kWh). Optional. Up to 5 digits after the decimal point depending on the currency precision.

pricePeriodInMinutes.description: Charging period. In minutes. It defines the time-period for charging a fee.

pricePeriods__connectionFeePeriods__fee.displayName: Price Periods - Connection Fee Periods - Fee

pricePeriods__energyFeePeriods__fee.displayName: Price Periods - Energy Fee Periods - Fee

pricePeriods__durationFeePeriods__fee.displayName: Price Periods - Duration Fee Periods - Fee

pricePeriods__idleFeePeriods__fee.displayName: Price Periods - Idle Fee Periods - Fee

pricing__thresholdPriceForEnergy.description: Price for kWh to be considered by Optimised charging for setting the charging periods.

pricing__priceForEnergyWhenOptimized.displayName: Pricing - Price For Energy When Optimized

pricing__durationFeeFrom.description: Defined start time for the application of duration fees.

pricing__durationFeeTo.description: Defined end time for the application of duration fees.

pricing__subsidyIntegrationId.description: The subsidy integration id that should be applied for this tariff. Only valid for Energy ToU tariffs. Please use the AMPECO.CHARGE backend for the specific integration id.

pricing__lockPriceOnSessionStart.displayName: Pricing - Lock Price On Session Start
pricing__lockPriceOnSessionStart.description: When enabled the tariff of the charger will be saved using the pricing interval when the user starts the charging session.

pricing__lockEnergyPriceOnSessionStart.displayName: Pricing - Lock Energy Price On Session Start
pricing__lockEnergyPriceOnSessionStart.description: When enabled the tariff of the charger will be saved using the pricing interval when the user starts the charging session.

pricing__lockDurationPriceOnSessionStart.displayName: Pricing - Lock Duration Price On Session Start
pricing__lockDurationPriceOnSessionStart.description: When enabled, the energy fee component of the tariff will be saved using the pricing interval when the user starts the charging session.

pricing__lockIdlePriceOnSessionStart.displayName: Pricing - Lock Idle Price On Session Start
pricing__lockIdlePriceOnSessionStart.description: When enabled, the duration fee component of the tariff will be saved using the pricing interval when the user starts the charging session.

pricing__stateOfChargeIdleThreshold.displayName: Pricing - State Of Charge Idle Threshold
pricing__stateOfChargeIdleThreshold.description: Switches the session to idle when the SoC (%) exceeds the selected value. Leave empty to use the system wide setting. This option will take effect only if `Allow custom SoC (%) threshold per Tariff` is set in `Idle period detection` setting.

pricing__averagePowerIdleThreshold.description: Sets the session to idle state when the average kW for the past 5 minutes is below the set threshold. This option will take effect only if `Allow custom power threshold per Tariff` is set in `Idle period detection` setting.

stopSession__timeLimitMinutes.description: Session max time. The maximum minutes a session is allowed to run. Skip for no time limit.

stopSession__stopWhenEnergyExceedsKwh.displayName: Stop Session - Stop When Energy Exceeds Kwh
stopSession__stopWhenEnergyExceedsKwh.description: The maximum energy (kWh) allowed per session. Skip for no limit.

restrictions__applyToUsersOfChargePointO.displayName: Restrictions - Apply To Users Of Charge Point Owner
restrictions__applyToUsersOfChargePointO.description: Makes the tariff apply to users of the partner, who is set as owner of the charge point.

restrictions__applyToUsersOfChargePointP.displayName: Restrictions - Apply To Users Of Charge Point Partner
restrictions__applyToUsersOfChargePointP.description: Makes the tariff apply to users of the partner, who is set as owner of the charge point.

restrictions__applyToUsersOfAllRoamingEm.displayName: Restrictions - Apply To Users Of All Roaming Emsps
restrictions__applyToUsersOfAllRoamingEm.description: Makes the tariff apply to users of all eMSPs, which are roaming partners.

restrictions__applyToAdHocUsers.displayName: Restrictions - Apply To Ad Hoc Users
restrictions__applyToAdHocUsers.description: Makes the tariff valid for non-registered users(ad-hoc charging).

restrictions__adHocPreAuthorizeAmount.displayName: Restrictions - Ad Hoc Pre Authorize Amount
restrictions__adHocPreAuthorizeAmount.description: Sets the amount that would be blocked on the user's card at the start of the session. Required if applyToAdHocUsers is true and one of the following billing strategies is chosen: `Require payment method and authorize certain amount before starting session` or `Require payment method OR minimum amount in balance`.

restrictions__adHocStopWhenPreAuthorized.displayName: Restrictions - Ad Hoc Stop When Pre Authorized Amount Falls Below
restrictions__adHocStopWhenPreAuthorized.description: Set the minimum pre-authorized amount threshold. When the remaining ad hoc pre-authorized amount falls below this value, the charging session will automatically stop to prevent revenue loss.

restrictions__applyToUsersOfPartners.displayName: Restrictions - Apply To Users Of Partners
restrictions__applyToUsersOfPartners.description: Users of specific Partners. Provide a list of partner IDs. Matches if the user is a invited to at least one of the partners.

restrictions__applyToUsersWithGroups.displayName: Restrictions - Apply To Users With Groups
restrictions__applyToUsersWithGroups.description: Users with a specific group. Provide a list of user groups. Matches if the user is a member of at least one of the groups.

restrictions__applyToUserGroupIds.displayName: Restrictions - Apply To User Group Ids
restrictions__applyToUserGroupIds.description: An array of user group IDs. Users with a specific group. Provide a list of user group IDs.

restrictions__applyToUsersWithSubscripti.displayName: Restrictions - Apply To Users With Subscriptions
restrictions__applyToUsersWithSubscripti.description: Users with a specific subscription plan. Provide a list of subscription plan IDs. Matches if the user has active one of the subscription plans.

restrictions__startDate.description: The date from which the tariff becomes valid.

restrictions__endDate.description: The expiry date of the tariff. The tariff is valid until this date inclusive.

partner__id.description: The assigned Partner will have access to make changes to the tariff.

display__defaultPriceInformation.description: The default information that would be shown on the display of the charge point without the user having authorized themselves.

display__defaultPriceInformationOffline.description: The information that would be shown on the display of the charge point when offline.

display__priceInformation.description: The information that would be shown on the display of the charge point for users that are eligible for this tariff.

display__totalCostInformation.description: Additional information that would be displayed on the charge point when the session ends, along with the total fees for energy, duration and idle.

integrationId.description: References the internal integration configuration that enables this tariff type

aiMetadata.description: Replace the full configuration of an existing AMPECO tariff identified by its numeric ID, including its type, pricing model, fees, restrictions, and display text. This is a full-replacement PUT, so supply all fields you want to keep; idempotent in that repeating the same payload yields the same final state. Use the create action to add a new tariff instead.

Permanently delete an AMPECO tariff by its numeric ID. Destructive: removes the pricing definition and cannot be undone, so confirm the tariff is no longer assigned before calling. Deleting an already-removed tariff will error rather than succeed silently.

transactionIssueInvoice.name: transactionIssueInvoice
transactionIssueInvoice.description: Issue ad-hoc invoice for the transaction (only if AMPECO invoice integration is used). For Számlázz.hu integration in Hungary, if a fiscalized receipt exists for the transaction, it will be automatically canceled and both the invoice and storno receipt will be sent to the user.

email.description: Email address to send the invoice

invoiceDetails__companyTaxAdministration.displayName: Invoice Details - Company Tax Administration Office Name

aiMetadata.description: Generate a new ad-hoc invoice for a transaction and send it to the given email, supplying individual or company billing details. Requires the AMPECO invoice integration to be enabled. To re-send an invoice that already exists, use the resend-invoice action instead. Not idempotent: each call issues a fresh invoice document.

transactionResendInvoice.name: transactionResendInvoice
transactionResendInvoice.description: Resend already issued invoice. If the transaction has an associated fiscalized receipt that was automatically canceled (Hungary compliance), both the invoice and the storno receipt will be sent together.

aiMetadata.description: Re-send the invoice already issued for a transaction to the customer. Use only when an invoice exists (use the issue-invoice action first if one does not). Not idempotent: each call dispatches the email/document again, so repeated calls send duplicate copies.

transactionUpdatePaymentReference.name: transactionUpdatePaymentReference
transactionUpdatePaymentReference.description: Link the transaction to external resource where the payment took place.

ref.description: Reference to the payment processor or payment terminal where more information about the transaction could be checked.

aiMetadata.description: Attach an external payment reference (e.g. a payment processor or terminal identifier) to a transaction so the payment can later be traced. Idempotent: it overwrites the reference field on the transaction, so re-running with the same value leaves the same end state.

filter__createdAfter.description: ISO 8601 formatted date. Lists only the transactions created after this datetime

filter__createdBefore.description: ISO 8601 formatted date. Lists only the transactions created before this datetime

filter__lastUpdatedAfter.description: ISO 8601 formatted date. Lists only the transactions that were last updated after this datetime

filter__lastUpdatedBefore.description: ISO 8601 formatted date. Lists only the transactions that were last updated before this datetime

filter__paymentMethod.description: Only list transactions by type of payment method

filter__userId.description: Only list transactions by a certain user

filter__invoiceNumber.description: Only list transaction by invoice number

filter__status.description: Only list transaction in this status

filter__sessionId.description: Only list transaction with this session id

filter__ref.description: Only list transactions with specific ref number.

filter__billingType.description: Only list transactions with the selected billing type.

filter__terminalId.description: Only list transactions with specific payment terminal id.

filter__finalizedBefore.description: ISO 8601 formatted date. Lists only the transactions finalized before this datetime

filter__finalizedAfter.description: ISO 8601 formatted date. Lists only the transactions finalized after this datetime

filter__voucherId.description: Only list transactions paid with this specific voucher id.

filter__purchaseType.description: Only list transactions with the specified purchase type(s). Determines what the transaction was for based on its associated entity.

per_page.description: When pagination is enabled: maximum total results across all pages. When pagination is disabled: number of results per API request (max 100).

usePagination.description: Whether to automatically paginate to fetch all results

aiMetadata.description: List payment transactions, with optional filters by user, status, payment method, date ranges, invoice, session, voucher, terminal, billing type, or purchase type. Read-only and idempotent. Enable the Paginate Results option to fetch across pages up to Per page total; otherwise a single page (max 100) is returned. Use transactionRead when you already know a transaction id.

Record a new payment transaction in AMPECO with a total amount, status, and optional payment method and session linkage. Not idempotent: each call creates a distinct transaction, so repeating it produces duplicate records. Use transactionUpdate to amend a non-finalised transaction.

Fetch a single payment transaction by its id, returning its amount, status, payment method and references. Read-only and idempotent. Use when you already have the transaction id; to search by user, status, or date use transactionsListing.

Modify an existing transaction identified by its id, changing its status, amount, payment method, or references. Idempotent: applies the supplied fields to that one transaction. Only works on non-finalised transactions; finalised ones cannot be edited. Use transactionsCreate to record a new transaction.

userActivateSubscription.name: userActivateSubscription
userActivateSubscription.description: Activate a subscription to a user.

endDate.description: The subscription will be valid until this end date

autoRenewal.description: Enable the auto-renewal of the subscription after the end date

reason.description: In case reason is empty, following text "Activated via API" will be added automatically

aiMetadata.description: Activate a subscription plan for a user, optionally setting an end date, auto-renewal, and a reason recorded in the audit log. Use cancel-subscription to end one instead. Not idempotent: each call activates a subscription, so re-running can create another or conflict with an existing active one.

userAddBalance.name: userAddBalance
userAddBalance.description: Add to the current balance of the user.

aiMetadata.description: Credit (or debit, with a negative amount) a user's account balance by the given amount, recording the required reason. Not idempotent: this adds to the existing balance, so each call shifts it further rather than setting an absolute value.

userApplyCustomFee.name: userApplyCustomFee
userApplyCustomFee.description: Apply custom fee for a user.

description.description: Shown to the user and also added to the user's bank statement (if the payment method is a bank card).

paymentMethodId.description: The ID of the payment method, as returned by the payment method listing (User / Payment Method / Listing). When left empty or null, it would take the balance and if the balance is insufficient, would reject the action. Corporate billing is not supported as a payment method.

aiMetadata.description: Charge an ad-hoc custom fee of the given amount to a user, optionally against a specific payment method (defaults to balance, rejecting if insufficient; corporate billing is not supported). The description is shown to the user and on their bank statement. Not idempotent: each call creates and charges a new fee.

userCancelSubscription.name: userCancelSubscription
userCancelSubscription.description: Cancel a subscription to a user.

reason.description: The reason for the cancellation. It would be included in the Audit logs.

aiMetadata.description: Cancel a user's active subscription, recording the supplied reason in the audit log. Use activate-subscription to grant one instead. Effectively idempotent on the end state (subscription ends up cancelled), but cancelling when there is no active subscription may error.

userChangeStatus.name: userChangeStatus
userChangeStatus.description: Set the status for a user.

status.description:
* `enabled` Enabled - the user is allowed to use the system
* `disabled` Disabled - the user is NOT allowed to use the system

aiMetadata.description: Enable or disable a user account (enabled = allowed to use the system, disabled = blocked), recording the required reason. Idempotent: it sets the account to the chosen status, so re-running with the same status leaves the same end state.

userClearSubscriptionAmountDue.name: userClearSubscriptionAmountDue
userClearSubscriptionAmountDue.displayName: Actions - Users - Clear Subscription Amount Due
userClearSubscriptionAmountDue.description: Clear a user's subscription amount due. Any unsettled transactions related to the user's current subscription — such as fees and charging sessions will be set to an amount of 0.This operation is irreversible.

aiMetadata.description: Zero out all unsettled amounts due (fees and charging sessions) on a user's current subscription. This is irreversible and only affects the user's current subscription. Effectively idempotent: once cleared the amount due is 0, so re-running has no further effect.

userExportAllPrivateData.name: userExportAllPrivateData
userExportAllPrivateData.displayName: Actions - Users - Export All Private Data

aiMetadata.description: Retrieve a full export of a user's stored private/personal data (read-only, for GDPR-style data-access requests). Idempotent: it only reads and returns data without changing anything.

userRedeemVoucher.name: userRedeemVoucher
userRedeemVoucher.description: Apply a voucher to a user.

code.description: The code of the voucher that should be redeemed.

aiMetadata.description: Redeem a voucher code on behalf of a user, granting whatever benefit the voucher carries. Not idempotent: each call consumes a redemption, so re-running may redeem again or fail if the code is single-use or already spent.

filter__userGroupId.description: Only list users that belong to a certain user group

filter__partnerId.description: Only list users attached to the partner.

filter__externalId.description: Only list users with specific external id

filter__email.description: Only list user with specific email

filter__externalAppData.description: Only list records with specific external application data. You can use a dot notation to search for nested properties. For example, `filter[externalAppData.property1.property2]=value`.

filter__lastUpdatedAfter.description: ISO 8601 formatted date. Lists only the users that were last updated on and after this datetime

filter__lastUpdatedBefore.description: ISO 8601 formatted date. Lists only the users that were last updated on and before this datetime

per_page.description: When pagination is enabled: maximum total results across all pages. When pagination is disabled: number of results per API request (max 100).

usePagination.description: Whether to automatically paginate to fetch all results

aiMetadata.description: List AMPECO users, optionally filtered by user group, partner, external id, email, external app data, or last-updated date range. Read-only and idempotent. Filtering by email or external id is the way to look a user up when you do not have their numeric id. Enable Paginate Results to fetch every page up to the Per page cap.

requirePasswordReset.description: Sets a requirement for the user to set a new password when they next open the app. After a new password is set, this option resets automatically.

token.description: Navigate to the API Access Tokens menu within your account.Click the Create API Access Token button to initiate the token creation process.

locale.description:
The language and regional settings to use in the app.

**Only available** if the option to update the user locale has been enabled for the operator.

externalId.description: Third party identifier of the user

options__sessionsAllowed.description: Determine the number of sessions a user could start - single or multiple simultaneous sessions, or whether the user could start simultaneous sessions with several Id Tags.

receiveNewsAndPromotions.description: Indicates whether the user has opted into receiving news and promotions. To opt in, set this field to 'true'; otherwise, set it to 'false'.

bankDetails__bankIban.description: IBAN that is provided for the user.

bankDetails__bankName.description: Name of the Bank for which the user has provided IBAN.

bankDetails__bankCode.description: Bank code assigned by a central bank, a bank supervisory body or a Bankers Association in the country.

bankDetails__bankAccountNumber.description: Bank account ID provided by the user.

bankDetails__bankAccountType.description: Type of account the user has provided.

nonce.description: A optional unique string that is used to prevent replay attacks. It's generated by the server, the client should pass it if the user is being created from an external sign up embedded web app and needs to automatically log in the user in the mobile app after creation.

aiMetadata.description: Create a new AMPECO user from an email and password, with optional profile, contact, address, group, and session-option fields. Use to register an account that does not yet exist; to modify an existing one use User Update. Not idempotent: repeated calls attempt to create duplicate users (and will fail if the email is already taken).

Fetch a single AMPECO user by numeric user id, optionally including partner invites or external app data and the current amount due. Read-only and idempotent. Use when you already have the id; to find a user by email or external id use Users Listing instead.

requirePasswordReset.description: Sets a requirement for the user to set a new password when they next open the app. After a new password is set, this option resets automatically.

token.description: Navigate to the API Access Tokens menu within your account.Click the Create API Access Token button to initiate the token creation process.

externalId.description: Third party identifier of the user

options__sessionsAllowed.description: Determine the number of sessions a user could start - single or multiple simultaneous sessions, or whether the user could start simultaneous sessions with several Id Tags.

receiveNewsAndPromotions.description: Updates the user's preference for receiving news and promotions. To change their preference, update this field to 'true' to opt in, or 'false' to opt out.

bankDetails__bankIban.description: IBAN that is provided for the user.

bankDetails__bankName.description: Name of the Bank for which the user has provided IBAN.

bankDetails__bankCode.description: Bank code assigned by a central bank, a bank supervisory body or a Bankers Association in the country.

bankDetails__bankAccountNumber.description: Bank account ID provided by the user.

bankDetails__bankAccountType.description: Type of account the user has provided.

aiMetadata.description: Update an existing AMPECO user, identified by numeric user id, changing profile, contact, address, credentials, group membership, session options, or bank details. Only the fields you supply are modified. Re-running with the same values is safe, but provided values overwrite the current ones. Use User Create to add a new user.

Permanently delete a single AMPECO user by numeric user id. Destructive and irreversible; confirm the id (e.g. via User Read or Users Listing) before calling. Not a safe retry against an arbitrary id.

Fetch the stored billing/invoice details for a single AMPECO user, identified by user id. Read-only and idempotent. Use to inspect current invoice settings before changing them with Invoice Details Create Or Update.

invoiceDetailsCreateOrUpdate.name: invoiceDetailsCreateOrUpdate
invoiceDetailsCreateOrUpdate.displayName: Resources - Users - Invoice Details Create Or Update
invoiceDetailsCreateOrUpdate.description: Create or update user invoice details.

requestBody_VariantType.description: Select the type of the variant

token.description: Navigate to the API Access Tokens menu within your account.Click the Create API Access Token button to initiate the token creation process.

aiMetadata.description: Upsert the billing/invoice details for a single AMPECO user, keyed by user id. The required fields depend on the selected invoice-manager variant (Ampeco, Cardcom, SoftOne, or Ecpay). Idempotent: it overwrites any existing invoice details for that user rather than creating duplicates. Use Invoice Details Read to inspect the current values first.

paymentMethodsListing.name: paymentMethodsListing
paymentMethodsListing.description: Get all payment methods for a user.

per_page.description: When pagination is enabled: maximum total results across all pages. When pagination is disabled: number of results per API request (max 100).

usePagination.description: Whether to automatically paginate to fetch all results

aiMetadata.description: List all payment methods registered to a single AMPECO user, identified by user id. Read-only and idempotent. Enable Paginate Results to fetch every page up to the Per page cap. Use to discover payment method ids before Payment Method Read, Update, or Delete.

paymentMethodCreate.name: paymentMethodCreate
paymentMethodCreate.description: Initiate a new payment method registration, or finalize it. Note that this is a two step process! # For payment processors with web view integration You will need to initiate a call with no parameters to this endpoint to get a new request to add payment method (Step 1). Then you will have to redirect to an endpoint and wait for the client to enter his credit card details there.

tokenizedType.description: The type of the tokenized payment method. If not provided - defaults to card

bankTransferType.description: The type of the bank transfer. Required if `tokenizedType` is `bank_transfer`

transactionId.description: The ID of the Transaction object, created when you initiated the request.

aiMetadata.description: Register a payment method for an AMPECO user via a two-step flow: call with only the user id to initiate a registration request, then call again with the returned transaction id to finalize. Optionally specify a tokenized type (card or bank transfer/SEPA). Not idempotent: each initiation starts a fresh registration. Use Payment Method Update to change an existing method.

paymentMethodRead.name: paymentMethodRead
paymentMethodRead.description: Get information for a payment method by ID.

aiMetadata.description: Fetch a single payment method for an AMPECO user, identified by user id and payment method id. Read-only and idempotent. Use Payment Methods Listing to discover the ids first.

paymentMethodUpdate.name: paymentMethodUpdate
paymentMethodUpdate.description: Update Payment method. Please note that ";balance"; and ";corporate"; payment methods CANNOT be set as default

aiMetadata.description: Update a payment method for an AMPECO user, identified by user id and payment method id; primarily toggles whether it is the user's default. Re-running with the same value is safe. Built-in 'balance' and 'corporate' methods cannot be set as default.

paymentMethodDelete.name: paymentMethodDelete

filter__receivedAfter.description: Filters CDRs by the time when received from CPOs, selecting records with a received time equal to or later than the specified value. This filter helps in selecting received records from a certain time and works for non local CDRs. The provided date-time should be following the ISO 8601 standard.

filter__receivedBefore.description: Filters CDRs by the time when received from CPOs, selecting records with a start time equal to or earlier than the specified value. This filter helps in selecting received records up to a certain time and works for non local CDRs. The provided date-time should be following the ISO 8601 standard.

filter__sentAfter.description: Filters CDRs by the time when sent to EMSP, selecting records with a sent time equal to or later than the specified value. This filter helps in selecting sent records from a certain time and works for local CDRs. The provided date-time should be following the ISO 8601 standard.

filter__sentBefore.description: Filters CDRs by the time when sent to EMSP, selecting records with a sent time equal to or earlier than the specified value. This filter helps in selecting sent records from a certain time and works for local CDRs. The provided date-time should be following the ISO 8601 standard.

filter__deliveryResponse.description:

parentCircuitId.description: Specify parent circuit in Multi-level DLM. Circuits used in flexibility assets or using load balancing integration can not be used in Multi-level DLM.

phaseRotation.description:
`R` stands for `L1`, </br>
`S` - for `L2` </br>
`T` - for `L3` </br>
So for example `RST` = `L1`, `L2`, `L3`, while `RTS` = `L1`, `L3`, `L2`, etc. </br>
The field is mandatory for Multi-level DLM when the `phases` value  is `three_phase`.

connectedPhase.description:
Specifies the active line conductors used in the circuit. </br>
Single phase values (`phases` = `single_phase`): `L1`, `L2`, `L3` - Valid in `star` electrical configuration </br>
Split phase values (`phases` = `split_phase`): `L1_L2`, `L2_L3`, `L1_L3` - Valid in `star` electrical configuration </br>
This field is mandatory for Multi-level DLM when the `phases` value is `single_phase` or `split_phase`.

electricalConfiguration.description: Defines the type of electrical configuration of the circuit. A circuit must have the same electrical configuration as its parent circuit. To maintain safety and compatibility, only charge points with an identical electrical configuration to the circuit can be added. To modify a circuit's electrical configuration, all charge points with a different configuration must first be removed through Actions / Detach Charge Point. The available options are </br> `star` - TN system - Star (Y) (default)</br> `delta` - IT system - Delta (Δ)</br>

maxCurrent.description: The current (A) limit for the whole circuit. This would usually be the circuit breaker rated current.

minChargePointCurrent.description: Defines what is the lowest current (A) allowed per charge point. New sessions cannot start if any of the existing ones has to be lowered to less than the set minimum rate. This is to ensure that a connected car vehicle actually charge because the vehicles have a minimum charging rate below which they would not accept the charge. If left empty, there is no minimum.

setSessionLimitToZeroOnIdle.displayName: Set Session Limit To Zero On Idle
setSessionLimitToZeroOnIdle.description: Sets the limit to 0 when the session enters an idle period.

electricityMeterId.description: The ID of the Electricity Meter linked to the circuit (if any).

offlineReservedCurrent.description: The current (A) reserved for other loads on the circuit (non-managed loads) when the Electricity Meter is offline.

powerOptions__maxVoltage.description: The maxVoltage of a charge point can fluctuate. Hence, when creating a charge point in the system, the maxVoltage is given as a range. For OCPI purposes it maps as follows: 220-240 = 230 110-130 = 120 400 = 400 380 = 380.

powerOptions__phaseRotation.description: `R` stands for `L1`, </br> `S` - for `L2` </br> `T` - for `L3` </br> So for example `RST` = `L1`, `L2`, `L3`, while `RTS` = `L1`, `L3`, `L2`, etc.

powerOptions__connectedPhase.description: Specifies the active line conductors used in the circuit. - `L1_L2` - Valid when `phases` = `split_phase` in electrical configuration `star` or `phases` = `single_phase` in electrical configuration `delta` - `L2_L3` - Valid when `phases` = `split_phase` in electrical configuration `star` or `phases` = `single_phase` in electrical configuration `delta` - `L1_L3` - Valid when `phases` = `split_phase` in electrical configuration `star` or `phases` = `single_phase` in electrical configuration `delta` - `L1` - Valid when `phases` = `single_phase` in electrical configuration `star` - `L2` - Valid when `phases` = `single_phase` in electrical configuration `star` - `L3` - Valid when `phases` = `single_phase` in electrical configuration `star`.

aiMetadata.description: List vouchers, with optional filters by type, status, code substring, redeeming user, and creation/redemption/expiry date ranges. Read-only and idempotent. Use this to search or count vouchers; to fetch one known voucher prefer Voucher Read. Enable Paginate Results for the full set across pages.

expireDate.description: RFC 3339 formatted date. Defines the date on which the voucher expires. The field can be calculated based on the `redeemedAt` timestamp and the `validityPeriod` field if the `validityPeriod` is set and the `expireDate` is not.

validityPeriod.description: Defines the validity period for the voucher. When a user redeems the voucher, this period is added to the `redeemedAt` timestamp to calculate the voucher's `expireDate`. This field is only used when `expireDate` is not already set - if `expireDate` has a value, this period is ignored and the defined `expireDate` is used instead.

assignBeforeDate.description: The date before which the voucher should be assigned to user in order to be valid. RFC 3339 formatted date

prefix.description: The prefix of the voucher's code.

aiMetadata.description: Create a new voucher with an amount and optional expiry/validity period, assign-before date, code prefix, description, and localized titles. Not idempotent: each call mints a distinct voucher, so avoid retrying on uncertain failures. To change an existing voucher use Voucher Update instead.
Fetch a single voucher by its numeric id. Read-only and idempotent. Use this when you already know the id; to discover vouchers by code, status, or date use Vouchers Listing instead.

nl.The ID of the charge point that is conne: Het ID van het laadpunt dat is verbonden met de backend en wordt gebruikt door dit laadpunt voor OCPP-communicatie. Vereist wanneer de `communicationMode` `via_ocpp_connected_charge_point` is.
nl.This property is required!</br>\nIt obso:
This property is required!</br>
It obsoletes the `managedByOperator` property, which can still be used by older implementations, so neither is marked as required.</br>
Indicates how the charge point communicates with the backend.</br>
`none` - the charge point is not connected to the backend. The charge point can be displayed to users with instructions how to use it. An informational notice can be associated with the charge point using the `noticeId` property.</br>
`direct_ocpp` - the charge point is connected through OCPP and is actively being managed by the backend.</br>
`via_ocpp_connected_charge_point` - the charge point is a satellite of another charge point which communicates through OCPP and is identified by `ocppConnectedChargePointId`. The charge point is not actively managed, but inherits most of its properties from its master charge point. When creating this type of charge point, the following fields are not required and will not be used:</br>
  - electricityRateId</br>
  - networkType</br>
  - capabilities</br>
  - network</br>
  - autoStartWithoutAuthorization</br>
  - disableAutoStartEmulation</br>
  - security</br>
  - modelId</br>
  - enableAutoFaultRecovery</br>
  - utilityId</br>
  - usesRenewableEnergy</br>
  - enabledRandomisedDelay</br>
  - integratedAt</br>
  - manufacturedAt</br>

nl.Type of connector available on the EVSE::
Type of connector available on the EVSE:
- **type1**: Type 1 connector (SAE J1772 AC)
- **type2**: Type 2 connector (IEC 62196-2 AC)
- **type3**: Type 3 connector (IEC 62196-2 AC)
- **chademo**: CHAdeMO DC fast charging
- **ccs1**: Combined Charging System 1 (CCS1/Combo 1)
- **ccs2**: Combined Charging System 2 (CCS2/Combo 2)
- **schuko**: Standard European household socket
- **nacs**: North American Charging Standard (Tesla)
- **cee16**: CEE 16A industrial connector
- **cee32**: CEE 32A industrial connector
- **j1772**: SAE J1772 connector
- **inductive**: Inductive/wireless charging
- **nema-5-20**: Domestic M NEMA 5-20 Socket
- **type-e-french**: French Type E socket
- **type-g-british**: British Type G socket
- **type-j-swiss**: Swiss Type J socket
- **avcon**: AVCON connector (Australian standard)
- **gb-t-ac**: GB/T AC connector (Chinese standard)
- **gb-t-dc**: GB/T DC connector (Chinese standard)
- **chaoji**: ChaoJi (CHAdeMO 3.0)
- **nema-6-30**: NEMA 6-30
- **nema-6-50**: NEMA 6-50

nl.Idle fee per minute. A fee per minute th: Idle fee per minuut. Een vergoeding per minuut die wordt toegepast tijdens inactieve periode (geen kosten).

nl.Connection Fee Minimum Session Energy (k: Verbindingskosten minimale sessie energie (kWh). Optioneel. Tot 5 cijfers na het decimale punt, afhankelijk van de nauwkeurigheid van de valuta.

nl.Pre-authorize amount. The amount to pre-: Vooraf machtigen van bedrag. Het bedrag om een sessie te autoriseren. Tot 5 cijfers na het decimale punt, afhankelijk van de nauwkeurigheid van de valuta.

nl.Set price for the intervals not specifie: Stel de prijs voor de intervallen niet gespecificeerd in het veld 'intervalPricing'.
nl.The time interval must be always the sam: De tijdsinterval moet altijd hetzelfde zijn en mag niet hoger zijn dan de 24-uur-markering. Het kan zijn of 15 min, 30 min of 60 min. De startdatum en einddatum moet voldoen aan deze beperking.

Het laatste level moet een oneindige waarde hebben voor **lastKwh**.

Het laatste level moet een oneindige waarde hebben voor **lastUnit**.

Het laatste level moet een oneindige waarde hebben voor **lastUnit**.

Gebruikers met een specifiek abonnement. Geef een lijst met abonnement-ID's op. Komt overeen met wanneer de gebruiker een abonnement actief heeft.

nl.Filters CDRs by the start time, selectin: Filtert CDR's op de begintijd, selecteer records met een begintijd gelijk aan of later dan de opgegeven waarde. De datum moet volgens ISO 8601 normen worden geformatteerd.

Filtert CDR's op de begintijd, selecteer records met een begintijd gelijk aan of eerder dan de opgegeven waarde. Dit filter helpt bij het selecteren van records tot een bepaalde starttijd. De opgegeven datum moet in ISO 8601 formaat zijn.
nl.This filter retrieves CDRs with an end t: Dit filter haalt CDR's op met een eindtijd gelijk aan of later dan de opgegeven waarde. Het helpt om records te filteren op basis van het einde van een tijdsperiode, waardoor alleen records die eindigen na een bepaald punt zijn geselecteerd. De datumnotatie moet voldoen aan de ISO 8601-normen.
nl.Filters CDRs based on their end time, se: Filtert CDR's gebaseerd op hun eindtijd, selecteer diegenen met een eindtijd gelijk aan of eerder dan de opgegeven waarde. Dit filter beperkt de selectie tot records die een bepaalde tijd worden afgesloten. De datumtijd moet in ISO 8601 formaat zijn.
nl.Only CDRs associated with a specific Roa: Alleen CDR's die zijn gekoppeld aan een specifieke roaming-operator/provider.
nl.Only CDRs linked to a specific Roaming P: Alleen CDR's gekoppeld aan een specifiek Roaming Platform.
nl.Filters CDRs by the unique identifier wi: Filteren op CDR's op de unieke identificatie van het platform van de CPO's (en sub-operator platforms). Als u dit filter gebruikt, zal het een enkel resultaat opleveren.
nl.If true only CDRs that we issued as CPO: Als alleen CDR's die we als CPO hebben uitgegeven worden teruggegeven, als er geen valse CDR's zijn die we hebben ontvangen als eMSP zullen worden teruggegeven.
nl.Filters CDRs by the time when received f: Filtert CDR's op het tijdstip dat ontvangen wordt van CPO's, selecteer records met een ontvangen tijd gelijk aan of later dan de opgegeven waarde. Dit filter helpt bij het selecteren van ontvangen records vanaf een bepaalde tijd en werkt voor niet-lokale CDR's. De opgegeven datum moet de ISO 8601 standaard volgen.

Filtert CDR's op de tijd wanneer ontvangen van CPO's, selecteer records met een begintijd gelijk aan of eerder dan de opgegeven waarde. Dit filter helpt bij het selecteren van ontvangen records tot een bepaalde tijd en werkt voor niet-lokale CDR's. De opgegeven datum moet de ISO 8601 standaard volgen.
nl.Filters CDRs by the time when sent to EM: Filtert CDR's op het moment dat het verzonden wordt naar EMSP, selecteer records met een verzonden tijd gelijk aan of later dan de opgegeven waarde. Dit filter helpt bij het selecteren van verzonden records vanaf een bepaalde tijd en werkt voor lokale CDR's. De opgegeven datum moet de ISO 8601 standaard volgen.

Filtert CDR's op het moment dat het verzonden wordt naar EMSP, selecteer records met een verzonden tijd gelijk aan of eerder dan de opgegeven waarde. Dit filter helpt bij het selecteren van verzonden records vanaf een bepaalde tijd en werkt voor lokale CDR's. De opgegeven datum moet de ISO 8601 standaard volgen.
nl.Filters CDRs that were sent to the EMSP:
Filtert CDR's die naar het EMSP zijn gestuurd op basis van hun uitleveringsstatus.
Gebruik dit dropdown filter om CDR's op te halen met een van de volgende statussen:
  - `success`: CDR's succesvol **geaccepteerd** door het EMSP.
  - `fail`: CDR's die zijn afgewezen** (niet geaccepteerd) door het EMSP.
nl.Specify parent circuit in Multi-level DL: Specificeer bovenliggend circuit in Multi-level DLM. Circuits gebruikt in flexibele activa of met behulp van load balance integratie kan niet worden gebruikt in Multi-level DLM.
nl.`R` stands for `L1`, </br>\n`S` - for `L:
`R` staat voor `L1`, </br>
`S` - voor `L2` </br>
`T` voor `L3` </br>
Dus bijvoorbeeld `RST` = `L1`, `L2`, `L3`, while `RTS` = `L1`, `L3`, `L2`, etc. </br>
Het veld is verplicht voor Multi-level DLM wanneer de `phases` waarde `three_phase`.
nl.Specifies the active line conductors use:
Specificeert de actieve lijngeleiders die worden gebruikt in het circuit. </br>
Enkele fase waarden (`phases` = `single_phase`): `L1`, `L2`, `L2`, `L3` - Geldig in `star` elektrische configuratie </br>
Split fasewaarden (`phas` = `split_phase`): `L1_L2`, `L2_L3`, `L1_L3` - Geldig in `star` elektrische configuratie </br>
Dit veld is verplicht voor Multi-level DLM wanneer de `phases` waarde `single_phase` of `split_phase` is.
nl.Defines the type of electrical configura: Definieert het type elektrische configuratie van het circuit. Een circuit moet dezelfde elektrische configuratie hebben als zijn bovenliggend circuit. Om veiligheid en compatibiliteit te behouden, kunnen alleen laadpunten met een identieke elektrische configuratie aan het circuit worden toegevoegd. Om de elektrische configuratie van een circuit aan te passen, moeten alle laadpunten met een andere configuratie eerst worden verwijderd door acties / loskoppelen van laadpunten. De beschikbare opties zijn </br> `star` - TN systeem - Ster (Y) (standaard)</br> `delta` - IT system - Delta (number@@0)</br>
nl.The current (A) limit for the whole circ: De huidige (A) limiet voor het hele circuit. Dit is meestal de rater van de circuitonderbreker.
nl.Defines what is the lowest current (A) a: Definieert wat de laagste stroom (A) toegestaan per oplaadpunt is. Nieuwe sessies kunnen niet beginnen als een van de bestaande moet worden verlaagd tot minder dan het vastgestelde minimumtarief. Dit om ervoor te zorgen dat een aangesloten auto daadwerkelijk wordt opgeladen, omdat de voertuigen een minimumlaadniveau hebben waaronder ze de kosten niet zouden accepteren. Als het leeg gelaten wordt, is er geen minimum.
nl.Sets the limit to 0 when the session ent: Stelt de limiet in op 0 wanneer de sessie een inactieve periode ingaat.
nl.The ID of the Electricity Meter linked t: De ID van de elektriciteitsmeter gekoppeld aan het circuit (indien aanwezig).
nl.The current (A) reserved for other loads: De huidige (A) gereserveerd voor andere ladingen op het circuit (niet-beheerde lading) wanneer de Electricity Meter offline is.
nl.The id of the load balancing integration: De id van de integratie van de lastbalancering (te vinden in de Ampeco backend). Geef 'null' op als je de load balancering integratie wilt uitschakelen en terug wilt keren naar het ingebouwde laadsaldo.
nl.The ID of the User Group the user must b: Het ID van de gebruikersgroep waar de gebruiker deel van moet uitmaken of het ID van de Partner waar de gebruiker een uitnodiging voor moet hebben. voor de ingestelde prioriteit van de sessie.
nl.The priority where 1 is equal to anyone: De prioriteit waarbij 1 gelijk is aan ieder ander, 2 is twee keer zo belangrijk, 0,5 is half zo belangrijk.
nl.When displaying amounts in this currency: Bij het weergeven van bedragen in deze valuta wordt het voorvoegsel toegevoegd voor het bedrag. Dit kan symbolen, bijvoorbeeld $ of pond.
Wanneer bedragen in deze valuta worden weergegeven, wordt het achtervoegsel toegevoegd na het bedrag.

nl.Used when setting price per kWh and per: Wordt gebruikt bij het instellen van de prijs per kWh en per minuut van tarieven.
nl.When enabled, the minor currency unit is: Indien ingeschakeld de kleine valuta eenheid wordt gebruikt voor het vaststellen van de elektriciteitsprijs voor flexibele tarieven en voor het traceren van stroomkosten in de huisoplaadapp. De kleine valuta-eenheid voor bijvoorbeeld de Amerikaanse dollar is de cent.
nl.The sign or letter for the minor currenc: Het teken of de letter van de kleine munteenheid. Voor bijvoorbeeld Amerikaanse dollar kan dit "pixel" of "c" voor centen zijn.
nl.The exchange rate from base to target cu: De wisselkoers van de basis naar de doelvaluta

de.`public` - a charge point visible on the:
`public` - ein Ladungspunkt, der auf der Karte für alle </br>
`private` sichtbar ist - standardmäßig auf der Karte versteckt und nur für den privaten Gebrauch - Unternehmen und ihre Mitarbeiter zum Beispiel. Die Sichtbarkeit des Ladungspunktes könnte in Partnerobjekt verwaltet werden, mit den verschiedenen Optionen für AccessType. </br>
`personal` - der Ladungspunkt konnte nur einen einzigen Eigentümer haben. Der Besitzer wird eingestellt, wenn der Benutzer das Ladegerät oder mit Aktionen / Besitzer wechselt. </br>
de.Required for personal charge points. The: Benötigt für persönliche Ladungspunkte. Die PIN sollte in der App angegeben werden, wenn der Ladungspunkt von einem Benutzer abgeholt wird. Darf nur Zahlen enthalten.
de.locationId is always a REQUIRED field fo: locationId ist immer ein REQUIRED Feld für kommerzielle öffentliche und kommerzielle private Gebühren. Es ist NICHT ein Pflichtfeld nur für persönliche Ladungspunkte.
de.If there is Electricity rate set to the: Wenn der Strompreis auf den Ladungspunkt eingestellt ist, werden die Stromkosten für jede Ladesitzung ermittelt. Dynamische Stromraten konnten nicht ausgewählt werden, nur die, die in der Ressource/Stromgeschwindigkeit erstellt wurden.
de.Only for personal charge points. Require: Nur für persönliche Ladungspunkte. Erfordert ein aktives Abonnement, um den Ladungspunkt zu nutzen.
de.Only for personal charge points. List of: Nur für persönliche Ladungspunkte. Liste der Abonnements für jeden Benutzer, von denen der Nutzer ein aktives Abonnement haben sollte, um den Ladungspunkt nutzen zu können.
de.Shows the system status of the Charge Po:
Zeigt den Systemstatus des Ladungspunkts. </br>
`enabled` - der Ladungspunkt ist voll funktionsfähig.
`disabled` - der Ladungspunkt würde auf der Karte nicht angezeigt, wenn es sich um eine kommerzielle oder kommerzielle Privatperson mit der entsprechenden Sichtbarkeitsoption handelt und auch nicht per ID abgeholt oder gefunden werden konnte, wenn sie persönlich ist (zu Hause). </br>
`demo` - fungiert als Simulator, so dass verschiedene Setups getestet werden können. </br>
'außerhalb der Bestellung' - der Ladungspunkt ist sichtbar und wird mit Benutzern geteilt, aber eine Gebührensitzung
de.This flag indicates whether the operator:
Diese Markierung gibt an, ob der Betreiber den Ladungspunkt aktiv verwalten kann. Wenn das Flag auf 
    falsch gesetzt ist, kann der Ladungspunkt trotzdem den Benutzern angezeigt werden aber sie können nicht beantragen, eine Sitzung darauf zu starten.

Veraltet. Bitte verwenden Sie stattdessen den 'CommunicationMode'.
de.`remote_start_stop_capable` - whether Re:
`remote_start_stop_capable` - ob Remote start/stop für den Ladepunkt </br>
`meter_values` möglich ist - ob der Ladepunkt Meter-Updates an das System </br>
`stop_transaction_on_ev_disconnect` senden soll - für laufende Sitzungen, wenn das Kabel ausgesteckt ist, sollte dies die Sitzung stoppen und wenn es zurückgegeben wird, wird eine neue Sitzung erstellt. </br>
`disregard_the_heartbeats` - nur für OCPP 1.5 SOAP. Der Netzwerkstatus wird standardmäßig basierend auf den Heartbeat-Nachrichten aktualisiert. Wenn diese Option aktiviert ist, wird der Ladepunkt immer als verfügbar behandelt und sein Netzwerkstatus würde nicht von den Heartbeat-Nachrichten abhängen. </br>
`display_messages` - Ladegerät hat ein Display und es ist aktiviert um Nachrichten anzuzeigen. Diese Fähigkeit wird automatisch aktiviert, wenn der Ladegerät den entsprechenden Konfigurationsschlüssel meldet. Beim Erstellen eines Ladungspunktes wird die Fähigkeit ignoriert, da sie beim Booten automatisch erkannt wird. </br>
de.The backend will try to set it 3 times a: Das Backend wird versuchen, es 3 mal bei Boot-Benachrichtigung zu setzen. Wenn der Ladungspunkt dies nicht unterstützt, verwendet das Backend das höchste Sicherheitsprofil, das der Ladungspunkt verwenden könnte. </br> Folgende Sicherheitsprofile werden unterstützt: </br> 0: `No Authentication` </br> 1: `Ungesicherter Trasport mit einfacher Authentifizierung (Plain-back Authentication)` - Es enthält keine Authentifizierung für das CSMS, oder Maßnahmen zur Einrichtung eines sicheren Kommunikationskanals.
de.The ID of the CP Model, if one is associ: Die ID des CP-Modells, wenn einer mit dem Ladepunkt assoziiert ist. Kann auf Null gesetzt werden, um das aktuelle CP-Modell zu entfernen, das mit dem Ladepunkt verknüpft ist. Denken Sie daran, dass das Ladegerät beim Booten das Hardware-Modell meldet und es automatisch aktualisiert wird.
de.The partner's corporate billing would be: Die Konzernabrechnung des Partners würde standardmäßig als Zahlungsmethode verwendet werden, , wenn ein Benutzer, der zur Nutzung der Abrechnung des Partners eingeladen wird, eine Sitzung über den Abrechnungspunkt beginnt.

de.The notice is only available if the char: Die Nachricht ist nur verfügbar, wenn der Ladungspunkt vom Typ `private` ist und der accessType `public_view_private_use` ist.
de.Tags can be used for filtering and group: Tags können zum Filtern und Gruppieren von Ladegeräten nach Tag verwendet werden. Wenn Sie einen PATCH-Eingang ausführen, sollten alle Tags mit dem Ladungspunkt verknüpft sein. Wenn Sie einen Tag aussetzen, wird er vom Ladungspunkt entfernt.

de.This property is required!</br>\nIt obso:

Es veraltet die Eigenschaft `managedByOperator`, die immer noch von älteren Implementierungen verwendet werden kann, so dass keiner der Eigenschaften als erforderlich markiert ist.</br>
Gibt an, wie der Ladungspunkt mit dem Backend kommuniziert.</br>
`none` - der Ladungspunkt ist nicht mit dem Backend verbunden. Der Ladungspunkt kann den Benutzern mit Anweisungen zur Verwendung angezeigt werden. Ein Info-Hinweis kann mit dem Ladungspunkt über die Eigenschaft `NotizId` verknüpft werden.</br>
`direct_ocpp` - der Ladungspunkt ist über OCPP verbunden und wird aktiv vom Backend verwaltet.</br>

Der Ladungspunkt wird nicht aktiv verwaltet, sondern erbt die meisten seiner Eigenschaften vom Hauptaufladungspunkt. de.If true only CDRs that we issued as CPO: Wenn wahr sind, werden nur CDRs, die wir als CPO ausgestellt haben, zurückgegeben, wenn nur falsche CDRs, die wir als eMSP erhalten haben, zurückgegeben werden.
de.Filters CDRs by the time when received f: Filtert CDRs nach der Zeit, wenn sie von CPOs empfangen werden, wobei Datensätze mit einer Empfangszeit gleich oder später als der angegebene Wert ausgewählt werden. Dieser Filter hilft bei der Auswahl der empfangenen Datensätze aus einer bestimmten Zeit und funktioniert für nicht-lokale CDRs. Die angegebene Datumszeit sollte der Norm ISO 8601 entsprechen.

Filtert CDRs nach der Zeit, wenn sie von CPOs empfangen werden, wobei Datensätze mit einer Startzeit gleich oder früher als der angegebene Wert ausgewählt werden. Dieser Filter hilft bei der Auswahl der empfangenen Datensätze bis zu einer bestimmten Zeit und funktioniert für nicht lokale CDRs. Die angegebene Datumszeit sollte der Norm ISO 8601 entsprechen.
de.Filters CDRs by the time when sent to EM: Filtert CDRs nach der Zeit, die an EMSP gesendet wird, wobei Datensätze mit einer Sendezeit gleich oder später als der angegebene Wert ausgewählt werden. Dieser Filter hilft bei der Auswahl gesendeter Datensätze aus einer bestimmten Zeit und funktioniert für lokale CDRs. Die angegebene Datumszeit sollte der Norm ISO 8601 entsprechen.

Filtert CDRs nach der Zeit, die an EMSP gesendet wird, und wählt Datensätze mit einer Sendezeit von gleich oder früher als der angegebene Wert. Dieser Filter hilft bei der Auswahl gesendeter Datensätze aus einer bestimmten Zeit und funktioniert für lokale CDRs. Die angegebene Datumszeit sollte der Norm ISO 8601 entsprechen.
de.Filters CDRs that were sent to the EMSP:
Filtert CDRs, die nach ihrem Lieferstatus an die EMSP gesendet wurden.
Benutzen Sie diesen Dropdown-Filter, um CDRs mit einem der folgenden Status abzurufen:
  - `Erfolg: CDRs erfolgreich **akzeptiert** von der EMSP.
  - `fail`: CDRs, die von der EMSP **abgelehnt** (nicht angenommen) wurden.
de.Specify parent circuit in Multi-level DL: Geben Sie die übergeordnete Schaltung in Multi-Level-DLM an. Schaltungen, die für Flexibilitätswerte oder die Nutzung der Lastausgleich-Integration verwendet werden, können nicht in Multi-Level-DLM verwendet werden.
de.`R` stands for `L1`, </br>\n`S` - for `L:
`R` steht für `L1`, </br>
`S` - für `L2` </br>
`T` - für `L3` </br>
So zum Beispiel `RST` = `L1`, `L2`, `L3`, während `RTS` = `L1`, `L3`, `L2`, etc. </br>
Das Feld ist obligatorisch für Multi-Level-DLM, wenn der `phases` Wert `three_phase` ist.
de.Specifies the active line conductors use:
Bestimmt die aktiven Leitungsleiter, die im Schaltkreis verwendet werden. </br>
Einzelphasenwerte (`phases` = `single_phase`): `L1`, `L2`, `L3` - Gültig in `star` elektrische Konfiguration </br>
Split Phasenwerte (`phases` = `split_phase`): `L1_L2`, L2_L3", `L1_L3` - Gültig in `star` elektrische Konfiguration </br>
Dieses Feld ist obligatorisch für Multi-Level DLM, wenn der `phases` Wert `single_phase` oder `split_phase` ist.
de.Defines the type of electrical configura: Definiert die Art der elektrischen Konfiguration der Schaltung. Eine Schaltung muss die gleiche elektrische Konfiguration haben wie ihre übergeordnete Schaltung. Zur Aufrechterhaltung der Sicherheit und Kompatibilität können nur Ladungspunkte mit einer identischen elektrischen Konfiguration an die Schaltung hinzugefügt werden. Um die elektrische Konfiguration eines Schaltkreises zu verändern, müssen alle Ladungspunkte mit einer anderen Konfiguration zuerst durch Actions / Detach Ladungspunkt entfernt werden. Die verfügbaren Optionen sind </br> `star` - TN System - Star (Y) (Standard)</br> `delta` - IT-System - Delta (<unk> )</br>
de.The current (A) limit for the whole circ: Die Stromgrenze (A) für den gesamten Stromkreislauf. Dies wäre in der Regel der Strombrecher bewertete Strom.
de.Defines what is the lowest current (A) a: Definiert was der niedrigste Strom (A) pro Ladungspunkt erlaubt ist. Neue Sessions können nicht beginnen, wenn eine der bestehenden Sessions auf weniger als den festgelegten Mindestsatz gesenkt werden muss. Damit soll sichergestellt werden, dass ein angeschlossenes Fahrzeug tatsächlich Gebühren erhebt, weil die Fahrzeuge einen Mindesttarif haben, unter dem sie die Gebühr nicht akzeptieren würden. Wenn Sie leer bleiben, gibt es kein Minimum.
de.Sets the limit to 0 when the session ent: Legt das Limit auf 0 fest, wenn die Sitzung eine Leerlaufperiode betritt.
de.The ID of the Electricity Meter linked t: Die ID des Stromzählers an den Stromkreis angeschlossen (falls vorhanden).
de.The current (A) reserved for other loads: Der Strom (A) reserviert für andere Lasten auf dem Stromkreis (nicht verwaltete Lasten), wenn das Stromzähler offline ist.

fr.`public` - a charge point visible on the:

fr.If there is Electricity rate set to the: Si le taux d'électricité est fixé au point de charge, le coût de l'électricité pour chaque session de chargement sera suivi. Les taux d'électricité dynamiques n'ont pas pu être sélectionnés, seuls ceux créés dans la ressource / le taux d'électricité.
fr.Only for personal charge points. Require: Seulement pour les points de charge personnels. Nécessite un abonnement actif pour utiliser le point de chargement.

fr.Shows the system status of the Charge Po:
Affiche le statut du système du point de charge. </br>
`activé` - le point de charge est entièrement opérationnel.
`disabled` - le point de charge ne serait pas affiché sur la carte si c'est un privé commercial public ou commercial avec l'option pertinente de visibilité ni ne pouvait être réclamé ou trouvé par ID s'il est personnel (domicile). </br>
`demo` - agit en tant que simulateur pour que différentes configurations puissent être testées. </br>
`hors commande` - le point de charge est visible et partagé avec les utilisateurs, mais une session de charge
fr.This flag indicates whether the operator:
Ce drapeau indique si l'opérateur peut gérer activement le point de charge. Si le drapeau est réglé sur

fr.`remote_start_stop_capable` - whether Re:
`remote_start_stop_capable` - si le départ/arrêt distant est possible pour le Point de Charge </br>
`meter_values` - si le Point de charge doit envoyer des mises à jour de compteurs au système </br>
`stop_transaction_on_ev_disconnect` - pour les sessions en cours, lorsque le câble est débranché, cela devrait arrêter la session et si elle est retournée, une nouvelle session sera créée. </br>
`disregard_the_heartbeats` - seulement pour OCPP 1.5 SOAP. Le statut du réseau par défaut est mis à jour en fonction des messages de pulsation. Lorsque cette option est activée, le point de charge serait toujours traité comme disponible et son état réseau ne dépendrait pas des messages de pulsation. </br>
`display_messages` - le chargeur a un écran et il est activé pour afficher les messages. Cette fonctionnalité est activée automatiquement lorsque le chargeur rapporte la clé de configuration correspondante. Lors de la création d'un point de charge, la capacité est ignorée car elle est automatiquement détectée au démarrage. </br>
fr.The backend will try to set it 3 times a: Le backend essaiera de le définir 3 fois à la notification de démarrage. Si le point de charge ne le supporte pas, le backend utilisera le profil de sécurité le plus élevé que le point de charge pourrait utiliser. </br> Les profils de sécurité suivants sont pris en charge : </br> 0: `Aucune authentification` </br> 1: `Trasport non sécurisé avec authentification de base (Authentification de plaine)` - Il n'inclut pas l'authentification pour le CSMS, ou des mesures pour mettre en place un canal de communication sécurisé.
fr.The ID of the CP Model, if one is associ: L'ID du modèle CP, si on est associé au point de charge. Peut être défini à NULL pour supprimer le modèle de CP actuel associé au point de charge. N'oubliez pas qu'au démarrage, le chargeur signale le modèle matériel et qu'il est automatiquement mis à jour.
fr.The partner's corporate billing would be: La facturation d'entreprise du partenaire serait utilisée comme méthode de paiement par défaut, lorsqu'un utilisateur invité à utiliser la facturation d'entreprise du partenaire commence une session sur le point de facturation.
fr.`private_view_private_use` - only users: `private_view_private_use` - seuls les utilisateurs invités par le partenaire avec l'option d'accéder aux points de charge privés peuvent voir ce point de charge sur la carte et l'utiliser.
fr.The notice is only available if the char: L'avis n'est disponible que si le point de charge est de type `private` et que le accessType est `public_view_private_use`.
fr.Tags can be used for filtering and group: Les étiquettes peuvent être utilisées pour filtrer et regrouper les chargeurs par étiquette. Lorsque vous faites une entrée PATCH toutes les balises qui devraient être associées au point de charge. Ne pas un tag le retirerait du point de charge.

fr.When enabled, if no electricity rate is:
When enabled, if no electricity rate is assigned to the charge point any roaming session will be marked as using renewable energy.
The actual energy mix can be specified in an electricity rate, which can then be assigned to the charge point. In that case the energy mix will be provided for roaming sessions.
This information can be gathered from the utility provider or third-party platforms that provide this information to the public.
fr.The ID of the charge point that is conne: L'ID du point de charge qui est connecté au backend et utilisé par ce point de charge pour la communication OCPP. Requis lorsque le `communicationMode` est `via_ocpp_connected_charge_point`.
fr.This property is required!</br>\nIt obso:
This property is required!</br>
It obsoletes the `managedByOperator` property, which can still be used by older implementations, so neither is marked as required.</br>
Indicates how the charge point communicates with the backend.</br>
`none` - the charge point is not connected to the backend. The charge point can be displayed to users with instructions how to use it. An informational notice can be associated with the charge point using the `noticeId` property.</br>
`direct_ocpp` - the charge point is connected through OCPP and is actively being managed by the backend.</br>
`via_ocpp_connected_charge_point` - the charge point is a satellite of another charge point which communicates through OCPP and is identified by `ocppConnectedChargePointId`. The charge point is not actively managed, but inherits most of its properties from its master charge point. When creating this type of charge point, the following fields are not required and will not be used:</br>
  - electricityRateId</br>
  - networkType</br>
  - capabilities</br>
  - network</br>
  - autoStartWithoutAuthorization</br>
  - disableAutoStartEmulation</br>
  - security</br>
  - modelId</br>
  - enableAutoFaultRecovery</br>
  - utilityId</br>
  - usesRenewableEnergy</br>
  - enabledRandomisedDelay</br>
  - integratedAt</br>
  - manufacturedAt</br>

localement par le point de charge en supposant qu'il soit configuré pour fonctionner en mode démarrage automatique / </br>

fr.Makes the base fee apply per each home c: Fait appliquer les frais de base pour chaque chargeur de maison appartenant à l'abonné.

fr.When true the allowance can only be used: Lorsque c'est vrai, l'allocation ne peut être utilisée que sur les points à payer à domicile appartenant à l'utilisateur. Dans ce cas, toutes les autres restrictions d’allocations n’ont aucun effet.
fr.The allowance can only be used on charge: L'indemnité ne peut être utilisée que sur des points de frais dans les pays de cette liste. Si vide, l'indemnité est valable pour les points de charge dans tous les pays, sauf ceux listés explicitement dans les pays exclus.
fr.The allowance cannot be used on charge p: L'indemnité ne peut pas être utilisée sur des points de frais dans les pays de cette liste.
fr.When true the allowance cannot be used o: Lorsque c'est vrai, l'allocation ne peut pas être utilisée sur les points de frais d'itinérance.

fr.Required when Post-paid Subscription pla: Requis lorsque les abonnements postpayés ont été activés pour le système.
fr.Applies separately per each personal cha: S'applique séparément pour chaque point de charge personnel appartenant à l'abonné qui nécessite ce forfait d'abonnement.
fr.A change from disabled to enabled is onl: Un changement de désactivé à activé n'est possible que pour les abonnements qui ne sont pas remplacés par un autre forfait.

fr.Only list tariff of this specific type: Liste uniquement des tarifs de ce type spécifique
fr.Only list tariffs managed by certain par: Liste des tarifs uniquement gérés par certains partenaires.

fr.Connection fee. A fixed fee that is appl: Frais de connexion. Frais fixes qui sont appliqués au début de la session. Jusqu'à 5 chiffres après la virgule décimale selon la précision de la devise.
fr.Price per kWh. Up to 5 digits after the: Prix par kWh. Jusqu'à 5 chiffres après la virgule dépendant de la précision de la monnaie.
fr.Price per kWh during the day. Applicable: Prix par kWh pendant la journée. Applicable pour la durée+heure énergétique de la journée. Jusqu'à 5 chiffres après la virgule dépendant de la précision de la monnaie.
fr.Price per kWh during the night. Applicab: Prix par kWh pendant la nuit. Applicable pour la durée+heure de la journée. Jusqu'à 5 chiffres après la virgule dépendant de la précision de la monnaie.
fr.Charging period. In minutes. It defines: Période de chargement. En minutes. Il définit la période de facturation des frais.
fr.Charging fee per period. Applicable for: Frais de charge par période. Applicable pour la durée+énergie. Jusqu'à 5 chiffres après la virgule dépendant de la précision de la devise.
fr.Duration fee limit for the whole session: La limite de durée pour toute la session si des frais sont appliqués.
Frais de charge par période pendant la journée. Applicable pour la durée+temps d'énergie de la journée. Jusqu'à 5 chiffres après la virgule décimale selon la précision de la devise.
fr.Charging fee per period during the night: Frais de charge par période pendant la nuit. Applicable pour la durée+temps d'énergie de la journée. Jusqu'à 5 chiffres après la virgule décimale selon la précision de la devise.

fr.Idle fee per minute. A fee per minute th: Frais de ralenti par minute. Frais par minute qui sont appliqués pendant la période d'inactivité (sans charge).
fr.Defined start time for the application o: Heure de début définie pour l'application des frais d'inactivité.
fr.Defined end time for the application of: Heure de fin définie pour l'application des frais d'inactivité.
fr.Idle fee limit for the whole session if: Limite de frais d'inactivité pour toute la session si des frais sont appliqués.
fr.Connection Fee Minimum Session Duration: Frais de connexion Durée minimale de session (min). Facultatif.
fr.Connection Fee Minimum Session Energy (k: Frais de connexion Énergie minimale de session (kWh). Facultatif. Jusqu'à 5 chiffres après la virgule décimale selon la précision de la monnaie.
fr.Duration Fee Grace Period (min). Optiona: Période de grâce des frais de durée (min). Facultatif.
fr.Min. price. Sets a minimum total amount: Prix minimal. Définit un montant total minimum par session.
fr.Pre-authorize amount. The amount to pre-: Pré-autoriser le montant. Le montant à pré-autoriser avant de commencer une session. Jusqu'à 5 chiffres après le point décimal en fonction de la précision de la devise.
fr.If Multi-tax Support has been enabled in: Si la prise en charge multi-taxes a été activée dans les paramètres Ampeco.CHARGE, vous pouvez fournir l'identifiant de taxe pour le tarif ici.
fr.Use the Electricity Rate of the Charge P: Utilisez le Taux d'Electricité du Point de Charge qui est déjà fixé et qui vise à suivre les coûts d'électricité.
fr.When ChargePointElectricityRate is set t: Lorsque ChargePointElectricityRate est réglé sur *false*, l'ID du taux d'électricité DOIT être fourni afin que les tarifs d'électricité pour le tarif soient connus.
fr.Set price for the intervals not specifie: Définir le prix pour les intervalles non spécifiés dans le champ `intervalPricing`.
fr.The time interval must be always the sam: L'intervalle de temps doit toujours être le même et ne doit pas dépasser la marque de 24 heures. Il peut être soit 15 min, 30 min ou 60 min. Le début et la fin doivent se conformer à cette restriction.
fr.Create the price levels according to the:
Crée les niveaux de prix en fonction du kWh.
Le premier niveau doit avoir une valeur zéro pour **premierKwh**.
Le dernier niveau doit avoir une valeur infinie pour **lastKwh**.

Créer les niveaux de prix en fonction de la durée de la session à partir du début du chargement.
Le premier niveau doit avoir une valeur zéro pour **firstUnit**.
Le dernier niveau doit avoir une valeur infinie pour **lastUnit**.
fr.Different price levels could be created:
Des niveaux de prix différents peuvent être créés en fonction de la durée de la période d'inactivité.
Le premier niveau doit avoir une valeur zéro pour **firstUnit**.
Le dernier niveau doit avoir une valeur infinie pour **lastUnit**.
fr.In minutes. Only for the Peak power leve: En quelques minutes. Seulement pour le niveau de puissance maximale tarif.
fr.When left empty, this means that this is: En cas de vide, cela signifie qu'il s'agit de la tarification standard qui serait appliquée en général sans tenir compte du jour.
fr.Price for kWh to be considered by Optimi: Prix pour kWh à être pris en compte par la tarification optimisée pour la fixation des périodes de chargement.
fr.Defined start time for the application o: Heure de début définie pour l'application des frais de durée.
fr.Defined end time for the application of: Heure de fin définie pour l'application des frais de durée.
fr.The subsidy integration id that should b: L'identifiant d'intégration des subventions qui devrait être appliqué pour ce tarif. Valable uniquement pour les tarifs ToU Énergie. Veuillez utiliser le backend AMPECO.CHARGE pour l'identifiant d'intégration spécifique.
fr.When enabled the tariff of the charger w: Lorsque cette option est activée, le tarif du chargeur sera sauvegardé en utilisant l'intervalle de prix lorsque l'utilisateur démarre la session de chargement.
fr.When enabled, the energy fee component o: Lorsqu'il est activé, le composant de frais d'énergie du tarif sera économisé à l'aide de l'intervalle de prix lorsque l'utilisateur démarre la session de chargement.
fr.When enabled, the duration fee component: Lorsqu'il est activé, le composant de frais de durée du tarif sera sauvegardé en utilisant l'intervalle de prix lorsque l'utilisateur démarre la session de facturation.
fr.Switches the session to idle when the So: Bascule la session vers le ralenti lorsque le SoC (%) dépasse la valeur sélectionnée. Laisser vide pour utiliser le réglage de l'ensemble du système. Cette option ne prendra effet que si le paramètre `Autoriser les seuils personnalisés SoC (%) par Tariff` est défini dans le paramètre `Détection des périodes d'inactivité`.
fr.Sets the session to idle state when the: Définit l'état de la session au ralenti lorsque le kW moyen des 5 dernières minutes est inférieur au seuil fixé.
